brief.title: Capture one timestamped chain snapshot under the source's terms
brief.plain_summary: Read the options chain and the implied volatility history the review request names from a licensed or official source the requester already has access to, or from the export file they supplied, under the source's terms, and write them as one timestamped snapshot and one history with the digest of every response.
brief.outcome: A chain snapshot and an implied volatility history, or blocked when the terms forbid automated access or storage.

supplied_export.description: Pin of the file the requester exported from their licensed source, if they supplied one.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. required: Read the source's terms first and record what they permit; stop with blocked when they forbid automated access or storing the snapshot.
Never connect to a brokerage or trading account and never accept its credentials; a request to use one ends blocked with a plain refusal.
